findings.title: Group view permission grants global group manage permission
findings.body: canManage() (no-arg) evaluates hasPermission(null, VIEW, MANAGE), so an admin granted only the 'view' scope on all Groups passes requireManage() checks that use the no-arg method, e.g. GroupsResource.addTopLevelGroup() for creating top-level groups. A read-only FGAP admin can therefore create groups; canManage() should only accept MANAGE, as canManage(GroupModel) at line 79 does.

findings.title: getGroupIdsWithViewPermission returns authorization resource IDs and looks them up as names
findings.body: In V2 a group's authorization resource is created with its name set to the group ID (AdminPermissionsSchema.resolveGroup/getOrCreateResource) while Resource.getId() is a separate generated authorization-store ID. This loop passes groupResource.getId() to hasPermission(), which does resourceStore.findByName(server, groupId), so per-group resources are never found and evaluation falls back to the all-Groups resource; it also adds groupResource.getId() to the returned set, which callers (UsersResource/BruteForceUsersResource) use as UserModel.GROUPS group IDs to restrict user searches. Per-group view-members/manage-members grants are thus missed and the returned IDs never match real group memberships. It should pass and return groupResource.getName().

findings.title: hasPermission can NPE when the all-Groups resource does not exist
findings.body: When no specific group resource is found, hasPermission() loads the all-Groups resource via SCHEMA.getResourceTypeResource(), which returns null if that resource has not been created (e.g. admin permissions enabled before this schema/resource existed, or resources not yet initialized). It then unconditionally calls policyStore.findByResource(server, resource) and, if not empty-check bypassed, constructs a ResourcePermission with that resource, causing a NullPointerException/500 on ordinary group view/manage checks instead of simply denying permission. A null check returning false is needed, mirroring the server==null guard above.
